facts.text: gym-gazebo2 describes itself as a toolkit for developing and comparing reinforcement learning algorithms using ROS 2 and Gazebo, built as an extension of gym-gazebo.
The installation instructions require ROS 2 Dashing and Gazebo 9.9.0, and state that lower versions such as 9.0.0 will not work.
The package registers MARA-v0 with entry point gym_gazebo2.envs.MARA:MARAEnv.
MARAEnv is a subclass of gym.Env.
MARAEnv launches the Gazebo launch description returned by generateLaunchDescriptionMara in a new service process.
The MARA launch description starts gzserver or gazebo with libgazebo_ros_factory.so and libgazebo_ros_init.so, then the MARA spawn and cognition nodes.

MARAEnv publishes JointTrajectory commands on /mara_controller/command, subscribes to JointTrajectoryControllerState on /mara_controller/state and /gazebo_contacts, and creates an Empty client for /reset_simulation.
The number of joints comes from the KDL chain and the observation dimension is numJoints + 6 + 12.
The action space is Box(-pi, pi) over numJoints and the observation space is Box(-inf, inf) of obs_dim.
take_observation concatenates joint positions, end-effector position error, end-effector velocities, current end-effector position and a 9-element rotation matrix.
getTrajectoryMessage writes the action values into JointTrajectoryPoint.positions and the configured velocity into velocities.
seed() seeds numpy's generator through seeding.np_random and returns [seed].

step() publishes the trajectory, takes an observation, calls collision(), computes the reward, sets done when iterator equals max_episode_steps, and returns the legacy four-tuple (obs, reward, done, info).
MARAEnv sets max_episode_steps to a default of 1024 that baselines can update.
collision() calls the /reset_simulation service when a contact message was received since the last check.
take_observation() calls rclpy.spin_once in a loop until a controller state message passes its stamp check; the loop has no timeout.
reset() calls the /reset_simulation service, resets iterator and returns only the observation.
close() destroys the ROS node, kills the launch process and its children, and shuts rclpy down.
MARAEnv.__init__ parses the process command line with getArgsParserMARA().parse_args().
MARARealEnv starts the launchReal description in a new launch service process.
launchReal runs the hros_cognition_mara_components node with the motors.yaml configuration and the real argument.
MARARealEnv uses /mara_controller/command for its robot publisher and /mara_controller/state for its subscriber.
MARARealEnv.step() publishes ut_mara.getTrajectoryMessage(action[:numJoints], ...) on self._pub.

determinism.notes: the fake resets a placeholder joint offset from a Python random generator seeded by reset(seed) or the preceding seed capability; the upstream environment seeds numpy through seeding.np_random (mara.py:294-296), and no trajectory was compared with it

fidelity.engine: gym-gazebo2:MARA-v0 analytic fake (no Gazebo, no ROS 2)
gaps: the fake is an analytic kinematic stand-in, not a recording: it replays no captured Gazebo, ROS 2 or MARA traffic and was never compared with the upstream environment

no Gazebo server, ROS 2 graph, MARA URDF, KDL chain, controller, physics engine, contact sensor or camera is loaded; the fake moves each joint a placeholder fraction toward the commanded position and fabricates a 24-value observation in the upstream concatenation order (mara.py:272-276)

upstream actions are absolute joint-position targets written to JointTrajectoryPoint.positions with a 1 ms time_from_start (ut_mara.py:84-102); the controller's tracking and joint limits are not modelled
upstream step() resets the Gazebo simulation through /reset_simulation when a contact was received (mara.py:280-292, 320) without ending the episode; the fake has no contacts

upstream step() and reset() wait without a timeout for a fresh controller state and reset() also waits for /reset_simulation (mara.py:235-243, 364-368); the e-stop latch cannot interrupt such a native call
one step is one environment step with no simulated or wall-clock duration; timestep_ms is 0 because the fake has no physics clock, while a live Gazebo world advances on its own engine clock
the 24-value observation size is the upstream size; every value is placeholder test data and no end-effector position, Jacobian or rotation matrix is computed

the legacy four-tuple done flag is adapted by the SDK bridge to terminated=True with truncated=False; upstream done marks the 1024-step iterator limit (mara.py:77-77, 298-354), which a Gymnasium environment would normally report as truncation

reset jitter, the tracking fraction, the reward and the 1024-step limit are fake test data marked as placeholders; the upstream reset restores the Gazebo simulation and the upstream reward is ut_math.computeReward
the live environment needs ROS 2 Dashing and Gazebo 9.9.0 (INSTALL.md:17-22) plus the MARA workspace from INSTALL.md; none of it is installed where the gate runs

no hardware backend exists: MARAReal-v0 (MARARealEnv) commands a real MARA arm by publishing JointTrajectory messages on /mara_controller/command to the hros_cognition_mara_components node that launchReal starts in real mode; that robot-arm path is out of scope
constructing MARAEnv parses the host process's command line, launches Gazebo, calls rclpy.init and waits without a timeout for /spawn_entity (mara.py:50, 67-73, 181-182); no sim backend is declared
snapshot and restore are not offered because MARAEnv defines no get_state or set_state method

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: Software latch only: the runtime refuses every step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset, and the last observation and tick stay readable. In a live MARA-v0 deployment Gazebo keeps running in its own process and the controller keeps executing the last published trajectory. The latch does not publish a zero JointTrajectory and does not stop a MARA controller on /mara_controller/command, including the real controller MARARealEnv uses.
